method: Independent source review and unchanged three-case Dart reproduction against the final isolated source snapshot

findings.problem: A sparse default-namespace section group could bind the w prefix to foreign metadata; the generic serializer reused w for native attributes and changed the retained foreign attribute and child identity.
findings.resolution: Choose an unused native prefix across the subtree and match namespace declarations by their exact qualified name, including after parser normalization.

findings.problem: mc:ProcessContent could retain an effective native mirror-margin setting or section geometry inside a foreign wrapper outside the modeled projection.
findings.resolution: Refuse ProcessContent settings, section snapshots and original document markup before publishing model mutations.

result.section: Page setup refuses ProcessContent section markup.

additional_regression_fixes: A namespace declaration may share local name w with native w:w; declarations now use exact prefix/local-name matching.
Repeated edits reuse parser-normalized namespace declarations without duplicate attributes or growing source metadata.
Pending general sectionFormat dimension changes retain their orientation behavior before a sparse pageSetup write.
Original markup-compatibility alternatives and enabled special settings are checked before mutation.
limits: The review does not establish complete Word object-model parity.
No Microsoft Office installation or Flutter editor was exercised.
